name: Retrieve a source
description: Retrieve a source Retrieves an existing source object. GET /v1/sources/{source}
context:
GET /v1/sources/{source}
Retrieves an existing source object. Supply the unique source ID from a source creation request and Stripe will return the corresponding up-to-date source object information.
Required: source (path)
Optional: client_secret (query) — The client secret of the source. Required if a publishable key is used to retrieve the source.; expand (query) — Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.; body (body)

name: Retrieve a Source MandateNotification
description: Retrieve a Source MandateNotification Retrieves a new Source MandateNotification. GET /v1/sources/{source}/mandate_notifications/{mandate_notification}
context:
GET /v1/sources/{source}/mandate_notifications/{mandate_notification}
Retrieves a new Source MandateNotification.
Required: mandate_notification (path); source (path)
Optional: expand (query) — Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.; body (body)

name: List source transactions for a given source.
description: List source transactions for a given source. GET /v1/sources/{source}/source_transactions
context:
GET /v1/sources/{source}/source_transactions
List source transactions for a given source.
Required: source (path)
Optional: ending_before (query) — A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.; expand (query) — Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.; limit (query) — A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.; starting_after (query) — A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.; body (body)

name: Retrieve a source transaction
description: Retrieve a source transaction Retrieve an existing source transaction object. GET /v1/sources/{source}/source_transactions/{source_transaction}
context:
GET /v1/sources/{source}/source_transactions/{source_transaction}
Retrieve an existing source transaction object. Supply the unique source ID from a source creation request and the source transaction ID and Stripe will return the corresponding up-to-date source object information.
Required: source (path); source_transaction (path)
Optional: expand (query) — Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.; body (body)

context:

name: Update a source
description: Update a source Updates the specified source by setting the values of the parameters passed. POST /v1/sources/{source}
context:
POST /v1/sources/{source}
Updates the specified source by setting the values of the parameters passed. Any parameters not provided will be left unchanged. This request accepts the metadata and owner as arguments. It is also possible to update type specific information for selected payment methods. Please refer to our payment method guides for more detail.
Required: source (path)
Optional: body (body)

context:
